newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Want Want China plan unfazed by Taiwan.
newsitem.headline: Want Want China plan unfazed by Taiwan.

text.p: Taiwan snack maker Want Want Holdings Ltd told Reuters on Wednesday Taiwan's plans to clamp down on China investment would not affect its investment plans in the country.
"Want Want Holdings' investment plans in China will not be affected by the Taiwan news," a company official said.

"All our investments in China are made through the Singapore-listed company, which is incorporated in Singapore and therefore not affected by Taiwan," said the official, who asked not to be identified.
Taiwan's Economics Ministry said on Wednesday Taiwan firms must not begin any projects in China without authorisation from its investment commission.
Share prices of Want Want ended in Singapore US$0.26 lower at US$2.94 on the news.
The company official said Want Want's would go ahead with its China investment plans.
It has several factories in China, which accounts for the bulk of the group's turnover and pre-tax profit.
